column4: This earth-creation verse places firm mountains above the ground and apportions its provisions; after 41:9 and before the sky's completion in 41:11–12, it adds a stabilized, provisioned lower structure.
The verse asks who made earth a settled abode and placed rivers and mountains within it; this is a distinct formulation of the section's inhabitable ground beneath the sky.
Abraham and Ishmael raise the House's foundations; this human construction gives a specific counterpart to the section's cosmic house built from upper roof and lower surface.
The speaker challenges denial by recalling creation from dust, then a drop, then formation as a man; it is another concrete human-formation argument beside the section's sky-versus-human comparison.
At the final boundary, the sky is rolled up like a written scroll; this gives a distinct reversal of the section's erected roof.
The condemned are sent toward a shade with three branches; this turns the section's overhead shade image into a threatening cover.
The next verse says that shade neither protects from flame nor shelters; its own contribution is the explicit failure of a covering to shelter.
The sky splits open at the judgment boundary, reversing the section's built and unbroken ceiling.
The sky becomes like molten metal; this reverses the section's firm roof into a changed, unstable upper surface.
The judgment scene says the sky will split open, another specific boundary to the intact roof.
The sky is stripped away; this gives a distinct removal of the overhead cover imagined as a roof.
The sky splits and turns rose-like at the judgment boundary, a further specific reversal of the section's ordered ceiling.
Mountains are moved and the earth laid bare; this reverses the section's pegged landscape and spread, habitable ground.
The earth is stretched out at the final boundary, a specific alteration of the section's spread ground.
The spider's house is called the weakest house; the verse is about false protectors, so its connection is only a boundary case for the section's built, protected cosmic dwelling.
